verification_methodology.disclosure: Kindergarten children follow turn-taking play-marker locomotion driven by native Microsoft Rocketbox FBX walk/run/turn/stop clips with planted sole tracking and moving MuJoCo limb capsules. Wet-floor deposition uses the coupled nozzle/mop-pad deposition model on registered floor geometry; child yielding/detour around the wet lane is a transparent social-response rule scored strictly from geometry and travel delay (zero fabricated human-contact Newtons).
